purpose: Private editorial bookmark (unlinked from site navigation). Read before writing a subsequent gameplay story; update ONLY after journal/log review and story publication. This dotfile is still visible in a public GitHub repository.
unprocessed_play_note: No gameplay has been reconciled to a completed, published story in this continuity file. A prewritten placeholder is not evidence of gameplay; inspect synced logs before establishing where to begin.
update_rule: After a story is approved and committed, record its date/path, last VERIFIED interaction/location, completed and outstanding quests, relationships, moral or personality changes, and any uncertainty.
